raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

SGLang loads an out-of-tree kernel plugin through `--monokernel-backend` (`sglang.srt.monokernels`). The NVIDIA megakernel plugin for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on GB300 (sgl-project/sgl-nvidia-mega#1) runs covered decode steps through the framework's existing forward entry, with its own step code over SGLang's loaded weights, so it needs no change to SGLang's model code.

One part of a DSpark step sits outside the model's forward: the draft proposal (`compute_base_logits` + `draft_markov_block` in the DSpark draft sampler). The plugin runs that proposal as one vocabulary-sharded kernel per rank. This PR adds the single framework entry point that needs.

## Modifications

1. `monokernels/runtime.py`: `install_monokernel_forward` keeps the object the spec built on the model, readable with `built_monokernels(model)`.
2. `monokernels/spec.py`: `BuiltMonokernels` documents an optional `draft_sampler` factory.
3. `speculative/dspark_components/dspark_draft_sampler.py`: `maybe_build_draft_sampler` calls the factory once with (gamma, max_bs, greedy_draft, noise, draft_tokens, step_logits, step_temperatures). The factory returns a function of the batch size. At each size, that function returns either the step that replaces `compute_base_logits` + `draft_markov_block`, or `None` to keep SGLang's proposal. When the factory is set, a sampled draft's `step_logits` are allocated zeroed up front. The factory is not gated on the draft spec's served keys.

Without a monokernel backend, or without the factory, the proposal runs exactly as today. There are no new server arguments or environment variables.

## Accuracy Tests

CPU unit tests:
- `TestMonokernelDraftSampler` (`test/registered/unit/spec/test_dspark_draft_block.py`): a plugin step replaces only the base logits and the Markov block, and its outputs land in SGLang's buffers; without a plugin step, the stock proposal runs with the same arguments.
- `test/registered/unit/monokernels/test_mono_framework.py`: the runtime keeps the built object on the model, and `built_monokernels` returns `None` without one.

End-to-end results with the plugin's draft proposal will be added.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No change without a plugin that sets the factory.

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+def _folded_draft_model(*, built=None):
+    """A draft model for the folded proposal; built is what a monokernel spec left."""
+    model = SimpleNamespace(
+        markov_head=VanillaMarkov(vocab_size=VOCAB, markov_rank=RANK),
+        sample_from_anchor=True,
+        confidence_head=SimpleNamespace(proj=SimpleNamespace(weight=torch.zeros(1))),
+        lm_head=SimpleNamespace(org_vocab_size=VOCAB),
+        compute_base_logits=Mock(
+            side_effect=lambda h: (torch.zeros(h.shape[0], VOCAB), h + 1)
+        ),
+        compute_confidence=Mock(
+            side_effect=lambda **kw: (torch.zeros(BS, GAMMA), torch.zeros(BS, GAMMA))
+        ),
+    )
+    if built is not None:
+        model.__dict__["_monokernels"] = built
+    return model
+
+
+def _build(model, *, greedy_draft):
+    return ds.maybe_build_draft_sampler(
+        draft_model=model,
+        gamma=GAMMA,
+        max_bs=2 * BS,
+        device="cpu",
+        tp_rank=1,
+        noise=DraftNoise(key=3, offset=torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int64)),
+        greedy_draft=greedy_draft,
+        tp_sync="sync",
+    )
+
+
+class TestMonokernelDraftSampler(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_a_plugin_step_replaces_only_the_base_logits_and_markov_block(self):
+        hidden = torch.randn(BS * GAMMA, HIDDEN)
+        input_ids = torch.arange(BS * GAMMA)
+        for greedy_draft in (False, True):
+            factory = Mock()
+            step = Mock(side_effect=lambda h, anchor: ("tokens", h * 2))
+            factory.return_value = lambda bs: step if bs == BS else None
+            model = _folded_draft_model(built=SimpleNamespace(draft_sampler=factory))
+            with (
+                self.subTest(greedy_draft=greedy_draft),
+                patch.object(ds, "draft_markov_block", side_effect=AssertionError),
+            ):
+                sampler = _build(model, greedy_draft=greedy_draft)
+                sampler(hidden, input_ids)
+            model.compute_base_logits.assert_not_called()
+            # the plugin writes into SGLang's buffers; a temperature-0 row it skips
+            # must read as finite logits in a mixed accept
+            kwargs = factory.call_args.kwargs
+            self.assertIs(kwargs["draft_tokens"], sampler.out)
+            self.assertIs(kwargs["noise"], sampler._noise)
+            self.assertIs(kwargs["step_temperatures"], sampler.params.step_temperatures)
+            self.assertEqual(kwargs["greedy_draft"], greedy_draft)
+            if greedy_draft:
+                self.assertIsNone(kwargs["step_logits"])
+            else:
+                self.assertIs(kwargs["step_logits"], sampler.step_logits)
+                self.assertEqual(sampler.step_logits.shape, (2 * BS, GAMMA, VOCAB))
+                self.assertFalse(sampler.step_logits.any())
+            self.assertTrue(torch.equal(step.call_args.args[1], input_ids[::GAMMA]))
+            confidence = model.compute_confidence.call_args.kwargs
+            self.assertEqual(confidence["draft_tokens"], "tokens")
+            self.assertTrue(torch.equal(confidence["confidence_features"], hidden * 2))
+
+    def test_without_a_plugin_step_the_stock_proposal_runs(self):
+        """Unset (no monokernel backend), and a batch size the plugin declines: the
+        stock base logits and Markov block run with today's arguments."""
+        declined = SimpleNamespace(draft_sampler=lambda **kw: lambda bs: None)
+        for built in (None, declined):
+            model = _folded_draft_model(built=built)
+            tokens = torch.full((BS, GAMMA), 7)
+            with (
+                patch.object(
+                    ds, "draft_markov_block", return_value=(tokens, None)
+                ) as stock,
+                patch.object(torch.cuda, "is_current_stream_capturing", lambda: False),
+            ):
+                sampler = _build(model, greedy_draft=False)
+                if built is None:
+                    self.assertIsNone(sampler.step_logits)  # sized on the first call
+                sampler(torch.ones(BS * GAMMA, HIDDEN), torch.arange(BS * GAMMA))
+            kwargs = stock.call_args.kwargs
+            self.assertEqual(
+                kwargs.keys(),
+                {
+                    "markov_head",
+                    "base_logits",
+                    "anchor_tokens",
+                    "draft_hidden",
+                    "step_temperatures",
+                    "noise",
+                    "tp_sync",
+                    "logits_out",
+                    "greedy_draft",
+                },
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(kwargs["base_logits"].shape, (BS, GAMMA, VOCAB))
+            self.assertTrue(
+                torch.equal(kwargs["anchor_tokens"], torch.arange(0, 20, 5))
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(
+                kwargs["logits_out"].data_ptr(), sampler.step_logits.data_ptr()
+            )
+            self.assertTrue(sampler.out[: BS * GAMMA].eq(7).all())
+            features = model.compute_confidence.call_args.kwargs["confidence_features"]
+            self.assertTrue(features.eq(2).all())
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
